business_model.claim: SharkNinja earns revenue by selling small household appliances under the Shark and Ninja brands.
quotes: The Company has identified two operating segments, Domestic and International, which are aggregated into one reportable segment that derives revenues from customers through the sale of the Company’s small household appliances, which are sold under two brands, Shark and Ninja.

business_model.claim: The company has two operating segments, Domestic (United States and Canada) and International (all other markets). They are aggregated into one reportable segment, so no separate segment profit is reported in these excerpts.
quotes: Domestic consists of the United States and Canada, and International consists of markets outside the United States and Canada.

business_model.claim: Sales are reported in four product categories: Cleaning, Cooking and Beverage, Food Preparation, and Beauty and Home Environment. Growth in the third quarter of 2026 was uneven across them: Cleaning rose 4.1% to $617.2 million and Cooking and Beverage rose 36.6% to $597.7 million. Food Preparation rose 18.3% to $485.5 million and Beauty and Home Environment rose 45.8% to $276.1 million.
quotes: Cooking and Beverage Appliances net sales increased by $160.3 million, or 36.6%, to $597.7 million

business_model.claim: Third-quarter 2026 net sales were $1,976.4 million, up 21.2% from $1,630.2 million a year earlier. Nine-month net sales were also higher, at 5,154,709 against 4,297,754 (table in thousands).
quotes: Net sales increased 21.2% to $1,976.4 million.

business_model.claim: Products reach customers through an omnichannel model made up mainly of retail and direct-to-consumer (DTC) channels.
quotes: We sell our products using an omnichannel distribution strategy that consists primarily of retail and direct-to-consumer (“DTC”) channels.

business_model.claim: The largest retail customers named are Amazon, Costco, Walmart, Target and Best Buy, plus many independent retailers.
quotes: Some of the largest retailers we sell to include Amazon, Costco, Walmart, Target and Best Buy, as well as a significant number of independent retailers.

business_model.claim: Channel mix moves gross margin because DTC sales usually earn a higher gross margin than sales to retailers and distributors.
quotes: Gross margin is generally impacted by changes in channel mix since our DTC sales usually generate a higher gross margin than sales to retailers and distributors.

business_model.claim: Domestic net sales rose 19.4% and International net sales rose 25.2% in the third quarter of 2026, so both regions contributed to growth.
quotes: International net sales increased by $133.2 million, or 25.2%

business_model.basis: stated in the cited items; the mechanism is management's description
business_model.claim: Revenue is driven by innovation and expansion into new sub-categories, and the count rose from 38 in the 10-K to 41 in the latest 10-Q. Management cited a new entry into water filtration with Ninja HydraSense.
quotes: We have built two billion-dollar+ brands that drive strong growth and innovation across the 41 sub-categories in which we compete today.
our entry into water filtration with the Ninja HydraSense

business_model.claim: Net sales are exposed to foreign exchange rates, competition, consumer spending habits and general economic conditions. The products are discretionary purchases.
quotes: Net sales are impacted by the effect of foreign exchange rates, competition, consumer spending habits and general economic conditions.
Our products are discretionary items for consumers.

business_model.claim: Cost of sales is mainly the purchase cost of goods from third-party manufacturers, inbound freight and tariffs. The company imports most of its products and depends heavily on its suppliers.
quotes: Cost of sales primarily consists of the purchase cost of our products from third-party manufacturers, inbound freight costs, tariffs, product quality testing and inspection costs
Our operation is highly dependent on our relationships with suppliers.

business_model.claim: Tariffs are a live cost driver. The company reports an additional 12.5% Section 301 tariff on covered imports from China, and it is responding with sourcing diversification, cost optimization, pricing actions and supplier negotiations.
quotes: an additional 12.5% on covered imports from China

In response to the evolving tariff environment, we have taken and continue to take mitigating actions across our buy-side and sell-side operations, including supply chain and geographic sourcing diversification, cost optimization and value engineering initiatives, targeted pricing actions, and supplier negotiations.

business_model.claim: Third-quarter 2026 gross margin of 59.2% (50.1% a year earlier) was lifted by tariff refund claims, which cut cost of sales. Adjusted gross margin was 55.9% against 50.3%.
